# AmigaOS Hunk reference corpus, generated by generate.sh.
# Do not edit by hand; re-run the script instead.

vasm: vasm 2.0f
vlink: vlink V0.18a

## align
  vasmm68k_mot -Felf -quiet -o aligned.o aligned.s
  vasmm68k_mot -Felf -quiet -o zeros.o zeros.s
  vlink -b amigahunk  -o expected.hunk zeros.o aligned.o

## archive
  vasmm68k_mot -Felf -quiet -o aligned.o aligned.s
  vasmm68k_mot -Felf -quiet -o helper.o helper.s
  vasmm68k_mot -Felf -quiet -o main.o main.s
  ar rcs libhelp.a helper.o aligned.o
  vlink -b amigahunk  -o expected.hunk main.o libhelp.a

## basic
  vasmm68k_mot -Felf -quiet -o helper.o helper.s
  vasmm68k_mot -Felf -quiet -o main.o main.s
  vlink -b amigahunk  -o expected.hunk main.o helper.o

## common
  vasmm68k_mot -Felf -quiet -o common.o common.s
  vlink -b amigahunk  -o expected.hunk common.o

## crosshunk
  vasmm68k_mot -Felf -quiet -o helper.o helper.s
  vasmm68k_mot -Felf -quiet -o main.o main.s
  (no vlink run: cross-hunk PC-relative reference)

## order
  vasmm68k_mot -Felf -quiet -o order.o order.s
  vlink -b amigahunk  -o expected.hunk order.o

## strip
  vasmm68k_mot -Felf -quiet -o helper.o helper.s
  vasmm68k_mot -Felf -quiet -o main.o main.s
  vlink -b amigahunk -s -o expected.hunk main.o helper.o

## zerofill
  vasmm68k_mot -Felf -quiet -o zeros.o zeros.s
  vlink -b amigahunk  -o expected.hunk zeros.o
